nodes.label: Confocal Laser Scanning Microscope (CLSM) + fluorescent probes for local pH assessment in acidic media in GDE configuration
nodes.description:
Confocal Laser Scanning Microscope (CLSM) + fluorescent probes for local pH assessment in acidic media in GDE configuration
Owner organization: ICPEES@CNRS/Unistra
Task: T1.2
Maturity: under development
Documentation: DOI: 10.1039/d3cp00938f (see Figure 2b)
Range of validity or processability: 
In pH, a 0.05 variation should be visible with a ratiometric probe; Spatial resolution is bound to the light and correction factors, i.e., 200 nm. A probe with a ratiometric signal in the 1 - 5 pH range shall be used 5 (with the Lysosensor Green DND 181)

nodes.label: Electrospray deposition of Catalyst Layers
nodes.description:
Electrospray deposition of Catalyst Layers
Owner organization: CIEMAT
Task: T2.4
Maturity: established method
Documentation: DOI: 10.1021/acsaem.1c01445
Range of validity or processability: 
- Coating area: up to 50 cm2  - CL thickness: up to 0.1mm - Substrate limitations: small electrical conductivity must be provided (dry Nafion PEM is OK) - Ink recipe: adjusted for each catalyst type (solid/liquid ratio, ionomer)
